answer: Our decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol incorporates a Sybil resistance mechanism leveraging verifiable delay attestations, which ensures a pulse of synchronized delays across agents, thereby preventing Sybil attacks. The economic cost of launching such an attack is prohibitively high, as the attacker must maintain a significant stake, which, if compromised, would plummet to the nadir of their reputation, rendering their relic of a compromised identity irrecoverable.
